question: How will Elexion Automotive's adoption of a complete direct-to-customer sales model by 2026 affect sales cycle duration, conversion rates, and average revenue per customer across the United States with franchise laws?

insights.question: What was the average sales cycle duration for Elexion Automotive dealership in the third quarter of 2024?
insights.answer: In Q3 2024, the average sales cycle duration for Elexion Automotive dealership was 29 days from initial customer contact to final purchase completion.

insights.question: What percentage markup did Elexion Automotive partnering dealers add to its manufacturer's suggested retail prices (MSRP) on average in 2024?
insights.answer: Throughout the year 2024, Elexion Automotive partnering dealers added an average markup of 9% above its MSRP.

insights.question: What percentage of Elexion Automotive customers who completed dealership test drives in 2024 proceeded to purchase within 60 days?
insights.answer: In 2024, 28% of customers who completed Elexion Automotive dealership test drives proceeded to purchase within 60 days, indicating a significant drop-off after initial contact with the customers.

insights.question: As of August 2025, how many sales representatives does the Elexion Automotive dealership network employ across North America?
insights.answer: As of August 2025, Elexion Automotive dealership employed 1737 sales representatives across North America.

insights.question: What was the average time for dealerships to respond to customers' inquiries about Elexion Automotive in 2024?
insights.answer: In 2024, Elexion Automotive dealerships took an average of 3 hours to respond to online customer enquiries, with 21% of leads not receiving any response.

insights.question: What is the average time Elexion Automotive vehicles spent in dealerships before being sold to customers in 2024?
insights.answer: During the year 2024, Elexion Automotive vehicles spent an average of 54 days in dealerships before being sold.

insights.question: What percentage of Elexion Automotive customers used the online configuration tool before visiting dealerships in 2024?
insights.answer: In 2024, 87% of Elexion Automotive customers used the online configuration tool to customize their ideal vehicle before visiting the dealership.

insights.question: Has Elexion Automotive secured legal counsel specializing in state franchise laws as of 2025 to support the direct-to-customer model transition?
insights.answer: Yes, as of February 2025, Elexion Automotive retained the law firm Jack Morrison & Rachael Pierce, which specializes in U.S. automotive franchise law.

insights.question: Are all of Elexion Automotive's current dealer partnership contracts set to expire or give room for termination by December 2025?
insights.answer: No, as of January 2025, all of Elexion Automotive's current dealer partnership contracts extend beyond December 2025.

insights.question: Is Elexion Automotive current CRM system capable of supporting a full direct-to-customer sales model as of July 2025?
insights.answer: No, as of July 2025, Elexion Automotive current CRM system is not capable of supporting a full direct-to-customer sales model. It is designed specifically for dealership management and lacks the customer-direct functionality.

insights.question: Can Elexion Automotive current manufacturing capacity support a shift to production for direct sales by Q1 2026?
insights.answer: As of January 2025, Elexion Automotive headquarters has the capacity to support a shift to production for direct sales by Q1 2026 based on 2024 and 2025 internal business strategies reports.

insights.question: What was the average revenue per customer under the dealership model in 2024?
insights.answer: The average revenue per customer under the dealership model in 2024 was $127,000.

insights.question: What was Elexion Automotive lead to sale conversion rate through dealerships in 2024?
insights.answer: As of December 2024, Elexion Automotive lead to sale conversion rate through the dealership network in 2024 was 12%.
